correctness.rationale: Two-sided stochastic convolution conditionally Gaussian with V=2D∫_0^∞e^-2κt c^(2N_t)dt, 0<V<v*=D/κ, and synchronous contraction ensures unique invariant law. At latest Poisson age E, W=v*-V satisfies W=U(v*-c²V'), U=e^-2κE~Beta(θ,1), θ=rate/(2κ). Since v*(1-c²)≤v*-c²V'≤v*, exact P(W≤w)=Cw^θ for 0<w≤v*(1-c²). Stationary generator gives moments m_k=∏_{j≤k}2κj/[2κj+rate(1-c^(2j))], so C has convergent binomial series. Boundary Laplace integration of the Gaussian mixture gives density x^-2θ exp(-x²/2v*) with the specified Γ constant and right survival an additional v*/x. Critical E exp[X²/(2v*)] finite iff θ>1/2, i.e., rate>κ.
